profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: These days, I'm a Software Engineer. I studied computer architecture and operating system kernel programming (and a bit of digital circuit design) at Carnegie Mellon University. My professional work experience consists of bug fixes and feature additions all over the software stacks of networked embedded devices, backend services, and build/deployment systems.

positions.description: Worked with a small team to develop a streamlined services platform on top of kubernetes and AWS, working mostly with Go and Python to develop components that controlled ingress, auth, rate-limiting, tracing, logging, monitoring, etc. Utilized Pulumi, Terraform, Datadog, GitHub Actions, and of course AWS services including EKS, RDS, SQS, S3, EC2, VPC ...

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description: Architected and built a platform for first-party video monitoring cameras offered by SmartThings, along with a small team. Cameras send and receive a few orders of magnitude more data than a switch, light-bulb, temp sensor, or even motion sensor: video clips, streaming video, and streaming "talk-back" audio to the camera, all don't fit directly in an events system designed and optimized for IoT, and need to go out-of-band. An efficient RTSP-over-TLS video gateway server was written in C using libevent, libretls, a modified nodejs/http-parser, and libwebsockets. A system for mp4 clip upload/download was written in Python-3.5+ using tornado and uses AWS S3 for storage. A core API and persistent command message bus system was built with python3/tornado/mariadb/memcached, to manage state of cameras, clips, and streams, and authentication and integration with the SmartThings core systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description: Worked on backend services terminating WebRTC connections and relaying video, written in C. Worked on higher level services which coordinated and balanced many users / cameras over a cluster of webrtc gateway servers, written in Python. Put together server deployment and monitoring systems. Used Amazon Web Services (ec2, s3, elb, route52), ansible, nginx, docker, nsq, mysql, mongodb, memcached, gstreamer, tornado and flask.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description: I worked with the infrastructure and ops teams to maintain servers, services, and applications, running on dedicated hardware in a partner's datacenter, and on Amazon Web Services. I worked on message queue based systems, many independent internal "services", an externally exposed http api, and many databases. I occasionally designed and implemented new database cluster topologies/schemes for greater perfomance and availability. I primarily used Python and Go, but also Bash, TCL, and C.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I worked on the firmware and build-system for multi-radio WiFi access points running a linux kernel. I also developed firmware for managed PoE injectors, which consisted of a small co-operative multi-tasking bare-metal application, offering http and snmp interfaces, running on a microcontroller.
